verdict.rationale: BILL's v3 API covers Spend & Expense and says developers can 'manage transactions & reimbursements', so an agent has a documented first-party path to read S&E transactions. S&E event webhooks could also signal new activity. The only MCP server documented serves API documentation, not live transaction data, so it earns no credit; the built-in AI categorization and Invoice Coding Agent are BILL's own features, not an external agent workflow. missing for 10: an endpoint or filter for uncoded transactions, documented API writes of category/GL coding back to transactions, any way to submit policy flags or route agent-proposed coding for review, a data-access MCP server, and hands-on corroboration.
